name: Benton County, IN
findings: Benton County has 34 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Benton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
